developers.name: Azorim
developers.summary: Azorim is a Tel Aviv Stock Exchange-listed residential developer that has been building homes across Israel for around six decades.
description: Azorim is one of Israel's longest-established residential developers, with a track record that stretches back to the mid-1960s. The company is publicly traded on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange and is chaired by its owner, Hershey Friedman. Its portfolio covers new-build neighbourhoods and towers in cities including Jerusalem, Tel Aviv, Haifa, Bat Yam and Be'er Sheva, alongside a dedicated urban renewal division and a rental arm.

Netanya is one of the company's most active markets. In the Park HaYam district near the southern beaches it is delivering the Hofim towers, while in the city's north it has a cluster of multi-tower schemes around Weizmann, Sokolov, HaRav Kook and HaHistadrut streets. These projects typically combine high-rise apartment buildings with shared amenities such as residents' lounges, gyms and landscaped open space. Taken together, they give Azorim one of the larger new-build footprints among developers currently active in the city.

projects.name: Azorim Hofim EAST
projects.description: Two 22-storey towers in the developing Park HaYam neighbourhood, a short walk from the beach and next to a large urban park.

projects.name: Azorim Hofim WEST
projects.description: A single high-rise on the western edge of Park HaYam, the row of towers closest to the shoreline, with a residents' lounge, gym and private garden.

projects.name: N Sokolov
projects.location: Corner of Weizmann and Sokolov streets, north Netanya
projects.description: Three 24-storey towers with roughly 264 homes, from three-room flats to penthouses, plus shared facilities including a gym and music room.

projects.name: N Weizman
projects.description: Three towers linked by landscaped green space, offering three- to five-room apartments and penthouses close to the sea and the Einstein interchange.

projects.name: N HaHistadrut
projects.location: Corner of HaRav Kook and HaHistadrut streets, north Netanya
projects.description: A three-building development near the city centre and train station, with communal workspaces, a residents' club and a park beneath the buildings.

developers.name: Aura Israel
developers.summary: Aura is a Tel Aviv Stock Exchange-listed developer that concentrates on urban renewal, replacing ageing housing blocks with new residential districts.
description: Aura Israel, whose listed entity trades on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange as Aura Investments, was founded and is run by its controlling shareholder, lawyer Yaacov Atrakchi. The company presents itself primarily as an urban renewal specialist, working with owners of older buildings to demolish and rebuild them at higher density under pinui-binui and similar schemes, while also developing some new neighbourhoods.

Its pipeline is spread across the country, from Haifa and the Krayot in the north to Jerusalem, the Tel Aviv metropolitan area and the south. In Netanya, Aura is behind one of the city's largest renewal plans: a multi-building redevelopment along Ben Zvi Street, branded AURA THE STRIP, which pairs new residential towers with commercial space and public facilities within walking distance of the beach. As with most renewal schemes, its timetable depends on planning approvals and agreement among existing owners.

projects.name: AURA THE STRIP (Netanya Ben Tzvi)

projects.location: Herbert Samuel / Sheshet HaYamim, Hadera city centre

projects.name: Aura Jerusalem
projects.description: A three-building renewal scheme on Hebron Road in Talpiot that replaces older housing and adds employment, commercial and public space.

developers.name: Africa Israel Residences
developers.summary: Africa Israel Residences is the TASE-listed homebuilding arm of the Africa Israel group, known for its Savyonim-branded residential communities.
description: Africa Israel Residences develops and builds housing across Israel and is controlled by Africa Israel Investments. Its shares trade on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange. Much of its output is marketed under the Savyonim name, a brand that traces back to the company's first neighbourhood in the town of Savyon and is applied to planned communities that include green space and local services alongside the apartments. An urban renewal subsidiary, Africa Urban Renewal, handles redevelopment schemes.

Netanya has been a recurring location for the company. Earlier completed projects include Savyoney Netanya and SKY Ir Yamim, followed by the Savion at the Lake tower in the Agamim area and the four-tower Savyon City Towers urban renewal scheme in the city centre. Current activity focuses on the west of the city, with Savyon Gardens in Park HaYam and Savyoney Hashmura near Ir Yamim, both close to the coastal parks and nature reserves on that side of Netanya.
areas: Projects across central Israel, Jerusalem and the north

projects.name: Savyon Gardens
projects.description: A plus-shaped tower surrounded by four themed gardens, designed so apartments avoid shared walls and have three exposures; close to the promenade and city centre.

projects.name: Savyoney Hashmura
projects.description: Four 22-storey towers with residents' clubs, near the Iris nature reserve, Ir Yamim Mall and Highway 2.

projects.name: Savyon City Towers
projects.location: Borochov / Andrius / HaRav Kook streets, central Netanya
projects.description: Four towers of 24 and 26 storeys designed by architect Haimi Schneider, close to the northern promenade.

projects.name: Savion at the Lake
projects.description: A 29-storey tower by Tishbi Rozio Architects beside the winter pond reserve, with all apartments facing west towards the sea.

developers.name: Ashtrom Residences
developers.summary: Ashtrom Residences, formerly Ashdar, is the wholly owned residential development arm of the TASE-listed Ashtrom Group.
description: Ashtrom Residences is the homebuilding subsidiary of Ashtrom Group, one of Israel's largest construction and real estate groups, whose shares trade on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange. The company operated for decades as Ashdar before being rebranded under the parent group's name, and it reports more than 40 years of experience planning and building residential projects. It is led by CEO Arnon Friedman.

Its activity spans standard new-build projects, combination deals with landowners and a large urban renewal programme covering both pinui-binui and NOP 38 schemes in major cities. In Netanya the company is developing Galei Netanya in the Park HaYam district, a two-tower project designed by Mann-Shinar Architects close to the beach and a green park. Elsewhere in central Israel it is active in Tel Aviv-Jaffa, Ramat HaSharon and Givat Shmuel, among other cities, often working with external architecture firms on each scheme.
areas: Central Israel and major cities nationwide

projects.name: Galei Netanya
projects.description: Two towers of 19 and 20 floors with 152 apartments, designed by Mann-Shinar Architects, with sea or park views and walking access to the beach.

projects.name: GO YAFO TEL-AVIV
projects.location: Heinrich Heine Road, Jaffa, Tel Aviv-Jaffa
projects.description: Five towers of 15 to 17 floors by Raleigh Levitzki Kasif near Jerusalem Boulevard, with a commercial floor and residents' country club.

projects.name: Ramat HaSharon Resort Strip
projects.description: Eight low- and mid-rise buildings on two adjacent plots, planned by Uri Zarubavel with only two or three apartments per floor.

projects.name: HADAR Givat Shmuel
projects.description: A 21-storey tower and an 8-storey boutique building with 122 homes, designed by Hook Architects.
